title: Loko
text: 2. Cattārimāni bhikkhave ariyasaccāni || katamāni cattāri || || 3. Dukkham ariyasaccaṃ || pe || dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ || || 4. Sadevake bhikkhave loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya tathāgato ariyo || tasmā ariyasaccānī ti vuccanti || || 5. Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti || || [page 436] 436 Sacca-Saṃyuttam LVI.
